label: GO step after a rewarded trial when the agent picks a1 (sparse within that context)
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=0 at GO, but prev_reward=1 always), and almost only when the policy chooses a1 (model_act==1 covers 99.9% of activation mass; 0.9% of mass goes to a2 choices). The gate predicate covers essentially all activations (dev recall 0.99, mass recall 0.999) but only ~9% of such steps fire, so precision is very low. Within the context, firing is more likely when the agent switches to a1 from a2 after reward (prev_action==2: precision 0.59, but recall 0.23), early in the episode (rate 5-6x in trials 1-9, falling to zero after trial ~85), shortly after a reversal, when S1 is the good state, and in a mid-high value band (7.73-8.10: 70% of mass). It does not fire at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or on a2 choices. No combination of these I tried got F1 above 0.35, so I recorded the simple gate. It probably carries a graded signal (early-episode or newly-adopted a1 choice after reward) in its magnitude, which I did not fully characterise. No future variables are used: model_act is the agent own choice and prev_reward is observed.
